eclair-blog-posts.title: Blog posts
eclair-blog-posts.goal: publish and organise blog posts with the native block editor
eclair-blog-posts.model: Post, excerpt, featured image, category, author, date, draft or published status
eclair-blog-posts.procedure: Create the posts as drafts through the admin or the MCP connector, check title, excerpt, image and category, then let a person publish
eclair-blog-posts.invariant: Never publish or delete content in place of the authorised person
eclair-blog-posts.pos: Create a complete draft, have it published, then check its rendering, the RSS feed and the sitemap
eclair-blog-posts.neg: A draft appears neither on the public site, nor in the sitemap, nor in the feed

eclair-static-pages.title: Site pages
eclair-static-pages.goal: create the site's static pages (home, about, services, contact) and their tree structure
eclair-static-pages.model: Page, address, blocks, parent page, status, menu entry
eclair-static-pages.procedure: List the pages needed, fix the addresses before writing, compose each page in blocks and link the pages to one another
eclair-static-pages.invariant: Never change the address of a published page without a verified redirect
eclair-static-pages.pos: Create the complete tree structure and check every address, the menu and the breadcrumb trail
eclair-static-pages.neg: A renamed page responds with a single 301 redirect, never with a 404 error

eclair-categories.title: Categories
eclair-categories.goal: structure content into pillar categories that are useful to visitors and to SEO
eclair-categories.procedure: Define a small number of stable categories, write their descriptions, attach each piece of content to a main category
eclair-categories.invariant: Do not create empty or duplicate categories that dilute the site
eclair-categories.pos: Create the categories, attach the content and check the category pages and their pagination
eclair-categories.neg: A category with no published content is not offered in the navigation

eclair-tags-taxonomies.title: Tags and taxonomies
eclair-tags-taxonomies.goal: carry over tags or custom taxonomies when the core only offers categories
eclair-tags-taxonomies.model: Term, taxonomy type, linked content, archive address
eclair-tags-taxonomies.procedure: Inventory the existing taxonomies, merge those that duplicate the categories, propose GET grouping pages for the rest and redirect the old archives
eclair-tags-taxonomies.invariant: Do not generate hundreds of thin indexable archives
eclair-tags-taxonomies.pos: Convert a set of tags into categories or grouping pages and check the redirects
eclair-tags-taxonomies.neg: A deleted old tag archive redirects to the closest page, with no chain

eclair-custom-content-types.title: Custom content types
eclair-custom-content-types.goal: model business content (projects, properties, events) without a custom content type in the core
eclair-custom-content-types.model: Business record, fields, list, address, status
eclair-custom-content-types.procedure: Choose between pages with dedicated blocks and an extension with its own storage and GET routes, fix the addresses, plan for list and record
eclair-custom-content-types.invariant: Never write to the core's content files from an extension
eclair-custom-content-types.pos: Create a record type through an extension, with list and detail in GET, then validate the package
eclair-custom-content-types.neg: An unpublished record is served neither in the list nor at its direct address

eclair-custom-fields.title: Custom fields
eclair-custom-fields.goal: add structured fields to blocks or to extension settings
eclair-custom-fields.model: Field, declared type, validated value, host block or setting
eclair-custom-fields.procedure: Declare the fields in the manifest (types supported by the core), let the core validate and store, render with escaping
eclair-custom-fields.invariant: Every displayed value goes through e(); no field contains a secret
eclair-custom-fields.pos: Declare a block with text, number and choice fields, then check validation and rendering
eclair-custom-fields.neg: An out-of-format value is rejected by the core and never reaches rendering

eclair-comments.title: Comments
eclair-comments.goal: design post comments with moderation and anti-spam
eclair-comments.model: Comment, author, moderation status, post, date
eclair-comments.procedure: Define the moderation queue, anti-spam rules, legal notices and cached display; in the meantime, propose an external service or a contact option
eclair-comments.invariant: No comment is displayed without moderation; no e-mail address is made public
eclair-comments.pos: Simulate the submission, moderation, publication and deletion of a comment
eclair-comments.neg: A pending or rejected comment never appears in a cached page

eclair-editorial-workflow.title: Editorial workflow
eclair-editorial-workflow.goal: organise a team's drafts, review and publication calendar
eclair-editorial-workflow.model: Draft, author, reviewer, planned date, status, schedule entry
eclair-editorial-workflow.procedure: Decide who writes and who publishes according to the native permissions, use the editorial schedule and drafts, keep a human review before anything goes live
eclair-editorial-workflow.invariant: An agent or a writer without publishing permission puts nothing live
eclair-editorial-workflow.pos: Take a piece of content from idea to draft and then to publication by an authorised person
eclair-editorial-workflow.neg: An account limited to content can neither change the settings nor publish in place of another role

eclair-authors.title: Authors and bylines
eclair-authors.goal: present authors with a verifiable biography and expertise
eclair-authors.model: Author, biography, job title, links, bylined content
eclair-authors.procedure: Complete the real profiles, link each post to its author, check the author page and the structured data produced by the core
eclair-authors.invariant: Never invent an author, a qualification or experience
eclair-authors.pos: Fill in a profile and check the byline, author page and markup
eclair-authors.neg: An account that is disabled or has no published content exposes no author page

eclair-navigation-menus.title: Navigation menus
eclair-navigation-menus.goal: build clear menus for the header and the footer
eclair-navigation-menus.procedure: Limit the main menu to the essential journeys, put the rest in the footer, test with keyboard and on mobile
eclair-navigation-menus.invariant: No menu link points to a draft or to an unintended external address
eclair-navigation-menus.pos: Compose the menus and go through them with the keyboard and on mobile
eclair-navigation-menus.neg: An unpublished page disappears from the menu or is flagged, never served as a 404 from the navigation

eclair-site-search.title: Site search
eclair-site-search.goal: offer fast internal search without a database
eclair-site-search.model: Index of published content, title, excerpt, address
eclair-site-search.procedure: Generate a static index of public content with a scheduled task, serve it as a cacheable GET and search on the browser side with a fallback page that works without JavaScript
eclair-site-search.invariant: The index contains only public content; no visitor query is logged with the visitor's identity
eclair-site-search.pos: Search for a term that is present, absent and accented, and check the response time
eclair-site-search.neg: A draft or a private page never appears in the index

eclair-rss-feeds.title: RSS feeds
eclair-rss-feeds.goal: check and make the most of the site's native RSS feed
eclair-rss-feeds.model: Feed, items, date, full content or excerpt
eclair-rss-feeds.procedure: Check the feed produced by the core, declare it in the pages, offer it to subscribers and aggregators
eclair-rss-feeds.invariant: The feed contains only published content
eclair-rss-feeds.pos: Validate the feed with a reader and a validator
eclair-rss-feeds.neg: Unpublished content disappears from the feed on regeneration

eclair-related-posts.title: Related content
eclair-related-posts.goal: offer relevant related posts at the end of the page
eclair-related-posts.model: Content, category, shared words, computed list of links
eclair-related-posts.procedure: Compute the associations on publication or with a task, render them with a cacheable static block, limit to a few links
eclair-related-posts.invariant: No association points to unpublished content
eclair-related-posts.pos: Check the links offered on several posts from different categories
eclair-related-posts.neg: A deleted post is no longer offered after regeneration

eclair-table-of-contents.title: Automatic table of contents
eclair-table-of-contents.goal: add a clickable table of contents to long content
eclair-table-of-contents.procedure: Generate the table of contents from the subheadings at server rendering, with stable anchors and no mandatory JavaScript
eclair-table-of-contents.invariant: The generated anchors are escaped and unique
eclair-table-of-contents.pos: Check the table of contents on content with three levels of subheadings
eclair-table-of-contents.neg: Short content with no subheading displays no empty table of contents

eclair-media-library.title: Media library
eclair-media-library.goal: organise images and files in the native media library
eclair-media-library.procedure: Import the media, fill in the alternative texts, identify unused files and duplicates
eclair-media-library.invariant: Only the formats accepted by the core are uploaded; no executable file
eclair-media-library.pos: Upload several formats and check conversion, dimensions and alternative texts
eclair-media-library.neg: A file in a forbidden format or a booby-trapped file is rejected on upload

eclair-image-optimization.title: Image optimisation
eclair-image-optimization.goal: take advantage of the native responsive WebP and lazy loading
eclair-image-optimization.model: Source image, responsive variants, dimensions, weight
eclair-image-optimization.procedure: Provide sources of the right size, let the core produce the variants, check the actual weight served on mobile
eclair-image-optimization.pos: Measure the weight and dimensions served on mobile and desktop
eclair-image-optimization.neg: No image is served without explicit dimensions

eclair-image-galleries.title: Image galleries
eclair-image-galleries.procedure: Compose the gallery as a CSS grid from the images in the media library, with captions and alternative texts
eclair-image-galleries.invariant: No image is loaded from a third-party domain
eclair-image-galleries.pos: Display a gallery of twenty images on mobile and measure its weight
eclair-image-galleries.neg: An image removed from the media library does not leave a broken thumbnail

eclair-video-embeds.title: Videos
eclair-video-embeds.goal: embed videos without slowing down the page or setting cookies
eclair-video-embeds.procedure: Use the native video block, prefer a clickable facade for third-party platforms, provide subtitles or a transcript
eclair-video-embeds.invariant: No third-party player is loaded before the visitor clicks
eclair-video-embeds.pos: Check that no third-party request is sent before the click
eclair-video-embeds.neg: A video address from an unauthorised domain is rejected

eclair-audio-podcast.title: Audio and podcast
eclair-audio-podcast.goal: publish audio episodes with a player and a podcast feed
eclair-audio-podcast.model: Episode, audio file, duration, notes, feed
eclair-audio-podcast.procedure: Create one page per episode with a native HTML player, generate the podcast feed in GET and host heavy files off the site if necessary
eclair-audio-podcast.invariant: The feed references only published episodes and public files
eclair-audio-podcast.pos: Validate the feed with a podcast validator and play an episode on mobile
eclair-audio-podcast.neg: A draft episode is absent from the feed

eclair-file-downloads.title: Downloads
eclair-file-downloads.goal: offer files for download (PDFs, templates, fact sheets)
eclair-file-downloads.model: File, title, version, size, host page
eclair-file-downloads.procedure: Store the public files in the media library, display weight and format, version the replaced files
eclair-file-downloads.invariant: No private or paid file is placed at a guessable public address
eclair-file-downloads.pos: Download each file and check the stated type and size
eclair-file-downloads.neg: A replaced file does not leave the old version accessible by mistake

eclair-sliders-carousels.title: Slideshows and carousels
eclair-sliders-carousels.goal: create a restrained slideshow that degrades neither speed nor accessibility
eclair-sliders-carousels.procedure: Prefer a single strong image; otherwise CSS scrolling with keyboard controls, pause and no imposed autoplay
eclair-sliders-carousels.invariant: No heavy third-party library; prefers-reduced-motion respected
eclair-sliders-carousels.pos: Navigate with the keyboard and a screen reader, measure the layout shift
eclair-sliders-carousels.neg: Without JavaScript, all the slide content remains readable

eclair-lightbox.title: Image viewer
eclair-lightbox.goal: enlarge images on click with a lightweight viewer
eclair-lightbox.procedure: Use the native dialog or a link to the image, handle focus, the Escape key and back, with no dependency
eclair-lightbox.invariant: Focus is trapped then correctly returned; no external content
eclair-lightbox.pos: Open, navigate and close with the keyboard
eclair-lightbox.neg: Without JavaScript, the click simply opens the image

eclair-pdf-documents.title: PDF documents
eclair-pdf-documents.goal: publish readable, accessible and indexed PDFs
eclair-pdf-documents.model: Document, title, summary, presentation page, file
eclair-pdf-documents.procedure: Create one HTML presentation page per document with a summary, a download link and an accessible alternative
eclair-pdf-documents.invariant: No PDF containing personal data is published without consent
eclair-pdf-documents.pos: Check the link, weight, document title and presentation page
eclair-pdf-documents.neg: A removed PDF returns a clean response and not a broken link in the pages

eclair-accordions-faq.title: FAQ and accordions
eclair-accordions-faq.goal: present questions and answers with the native FAQ block
eclair-accordions-faq.procedure: Write real customer questions, use the native FAQ block, which also produces the markup, limit the number per page
eclair-accordions-faq.invariant: No invented answer or unverified promise
eclair-accordions-faq.pos: Check keyboard opening and the markup produced
eclair-accordions-faq.neg: An empty FAQ emits no markup

eclair-tabs.title: Tabs
eclair-tabs.procedure: Build a tabs block with ARIA roles, arrow-key navigation and a fallback to stacked sections
eclair-tabs.invariant: All the content stays in the HTML, and is therefore readable without JavaScript
eclair-tabs.pos: Go through the tabs with the keyboard and a screen reader
eclair-tabs.neg: Without JavaScript, all the panels are visible

eclair-data-tables.title: Data tables
eclair-data-tables.goal: present tables that are readable on mobile
eclair-data-tables.procedure: Use the native table block, add a caption and headers, plan for controlled horizontal scrolling
eclair-data-tables.invariant: No personal data in a public table without consent
eclair-data-tables.pos: Read the table on mobile and with a screen reader
eclair-data-tables.neg: A wide table does not cause the whole page to scroll horizontally

eclair-pricing-tables.title: Pricing tables
eclair-pricing-tables.goal: present plans and prices clearly and honestly
eclair-pricing-tables.procedure: Compose the plans as comparable cards, display prices including or excluding tax without ambiguity and link each button to the right action
eclair-pricing-tables.invariant: No invented price, discount or legal notice
eclair-pricing-tables.pos: Compare three plans on mobile and check every link
eclair-pricing-tables.neg: A plan without a validated price is not displayed

eclair-timelines.title: Timelines
eclair-timelines.goal: tell a story or describe a process in dated steps
eclair-timelines.procedure: Render the timeline as an ordered list styled in CSS, readable as a column on mobile
eclair-timelines.invariant: The dates and facts displayed are provided by the client
eclair-timelines.pos: Check the reading order and the mobile display
eclair-timelines.neg: A step without a date remains readable and in order

eclair-countdowns.title: Countdowns
eclair-countdowns.goal: display a countdown to a real date
eclair-countdowns.model: Target date, time zone, end message
eclair-countdowns.procedure: Write the date in the HTML, animate as a progressive enhancement, plan for the state after the deadline and for cache invalidation
eclair-countdowns.invariant: No false urgency: the date corresponds to a real event
eclair-countdowns.pos: Test before, during and after the deadline and in two time zones
eclair-countdowns.neg: After the deadline, the cached page no longer displays an expired offer

eclair-team-members.title: Team
eclair-team-members.goal: present the team with the native block
eclair-team-members.model: Person, job title, photo, short biography
eclair-team-members.procedure: Use the native team block with consistent photos and texts provided by the people themselves
eclair-team-members.invariant: No photo or information is published without the person's consent
eclair-team-members.pos: Display the team on mobile with correct alternative texts
eclair-team-members.neg: A removed person also disappears from the cached pages

eclair-logo-walls.title: Client and partner logos
eclair-logo-walls.goal: display logos of authorised clients or partners
eclair-logo-walls.procedure: Display the logos in a static grid, consistent sizes, names as alternative text
eclair-logo-walls.invariant: Only logos whose use is authorised are published
eclair-logo-walls.pos: Check legibility in light and dark mode
eclair-logo-walls.neg: A logo without a recorded authorisation is not included

eclair-cta-sections.title: Calls to action
eclair-cta-sections.goal: place clear calls to action with the native blocks
eclair-cta-sections.procedure: Define one main action per page, repeat it in the right places, check contrast and an explicit label
eclair-cta-sections.invariant: No misleading link and no open redirect
eclair-cta-sections.pos: Follow each button to its destination on mobile
eclair-cta-sections.neg: A button without a valid destination is not published

eclair-hero-sections.title: Hero sections
eclair-hero-sections.goal: compose a strong opening section with the native block
eclair-hero-sections.procedure: Write a precise promise, choose a lightweight image, keep a single main heading and one button
eclair-hero-sections.invariant: The main image has explicit dimensions and does not delay rendering
eclair-hero-sections.pos: Measure the rendering of the largest element on mobile
eclair-hero-sections.neg: Without an image, the section remains readable and well contrasted

eclair-headers-footers.title: Headers and footers
eclair-headers-footers.goal: customise the header and footer through a site theme
eclair-headers-footers.model: Logo, menu, contact details, legal links
eclair-headers-footers.procedure: Go through a theme package in site/themes, respect the variables of the theme contract, keep the skip link and the legal links
eclair-headers-footers.invariant: Never generate SEO tags or headers already provided by the core yourself
eclair-headers-footers.pos: Validate the theme and check the header and footer on all the typical pages
eclair-headers-footers.neg: A theme rejected by the validator is not delivered

eclair-breadcrumbs.title: Breadcrumb trail
eclair-breadcrumbs.goal: check the native breadcrumb trail and its markup
eclair-breadcrumbs.procedure: Check the consistency between the tree structure, the displayed breadcrumb trail and the core's structured data
eclair-breadcrumbs.invariant: The breadcrumb trail reveals no unpublished page
eclair-breadcrumbs.pos: Compare the displayed trail and the markup over three levels of depth
eclair-breadcrumbs.neg: An orphan page does not display an inconsistent trail

eclair-pagination.title: Pagination and lists
eclair-pagination.goal: paginate lists of posts and records cleanly
eclair-pagination.model: List, current page, page size, previous and next links
eclair-pagination.procedure: Set a reasonable page size, stable addresses per page and accessible links
eclair-pagination.invariant: The page parameters are bounded and validated
eclair-pagination.pos: Go through the first page, a middle page and the last page
eclair-pagination.neg: An out-of-range page number responds with a clean error, not with an indexable empty list

eclair-dark-mode.title: Dark mode
eclair-dark-mode.goal: offer a dark mode that is faithful to the brand guidelines
eclair-dark-mode.model: Light and dark colour schemes, visitor preference
eclair-dark-mode.procedure: Define the theme's colour variables for prefers-color-scheme, check contrasts, images and logos
eclair-dark-mode.invariant: No cookie is needed to respect the system preference
eclair-dark-mode.pos: Check the contrasts of both modes on the typical pages
eclair-dark-mode.neg: A dark logo does not become invisible in dark mode

eclair-design.title: Éclair art direction
eclair-design.goal: create consistent sites with éclair design and the native theme
eclair-design.model: Positioning, identity, typography, colours, components, photographs and real content
eclair-design.procedure: Define a visual world drawn from the business, compose sections, adjust CSS and test themes with real content; favour site/themes and the existing blocks
eclair-design.invariant: Never modify app/theme/ or break the SEO, the CSP or the fast path
eclair-design.pos: Test contrast, multi-page consistency and mobile versions
eclair-design.neg: The new appearance remains readable without JavaScript and respects the existing links

eclair-theme-builder.title: Theme creation
eclair-theme-builder.goal: produce an éclair v2 theme that is update-compatible
eclair-theme-builder.model: theme.json, styles, assets, declared templates, licence and provenance
eclair-theme-builder.procedure: Start from the official example theme, use supported variables and templates, test the preview then the ZIP, check version compatibility
eclair-theme-builder.invariant: Never redo the SEO head and canonical or touch the core files
eclair-theme-builder.pos: Test the theme validator, activation, preview and rollback
eclair-theme-builder.neg: A faulty template does not make the site inaccessible, thanks to the planned fallback

eclair-blocks-library.title: Block library
eclair-blocks-library.goal: compose editable content blocks and extensions
eclair-blocks-library.model: Namespaced type, field declaration, limits, rendering and preserved data
eclair-blocks-library.procedure: Favour native blocks; declare the allowed fields; generate escaped rendering, default values and preservation after deactivation
eclair-blocks-library.invariant: Refuse to execute HTML/JS coming from fields; no data loss when the block is missing
eclair-blocks-library.pos: Test invalid fields, removal of the extension and reinstallation
eclair-blocks-library.neg: The deactivated block is kept but neither executed nor rendered

eclair-accessibility.title: WCAG accessibility
eclair-accessibility.goal: audit and fix an éclair interface so that it is accessible
eclair-accessibility.model: Heading structure, keyboard navigation, focus, forms, media, contrasts
eclair-accessibility.procedure: Carry out a keyboard and screen reader audit, check axe-core, contrasts, error messages and reduced motion
eclair-accessibility.invariant: Do not remove visible focus or make a feature depend solely on colour or gesture
eclair-accessibility.pos: Test mouse-free journeys, form errors and 200% zoom
eclair-accessibility.neg: A form remains understandable without colour and from the keyboard

eclair-design-system.title: Design system
eclair-design-system.goal: build a consistent and maintainable visual language
eclair-design-system.model: Tokens, grid, spacing, colours, typography, components and states
eclair-design-system.procedure: Declare the token scale, reuse components, document states and variants; Éclair theme compatibility
eclair-design-system.invariant: Do not introduce a heavy CSS stylesheet or a JS library without proof of need
eclair-design-system.pos: Test contrast, consistency and theme switching
eclair-design-system.neg: Changing the main colour makes no links or errors illegible

eclair-responsive-ux.title: Responsive UX
eclair-responsive-ux.goal: optimise mobile navigation, forms and layouts
eclair-responsive-ux.model: Breakpoints, density, text width, menu, forms and media
eclair-responsive-ux.procedure: Design mobile-first; keep the information hierarchy; test small screens, target sizes and orientations
eclair-responsive-ux.invariant: No essential content hidden on mobile or dependent on animation
eclair-responsive-ux.neg: A primary action remains visible and usable on a narrow screen without horizontal scrolling

eclair-performance-ux.title: Performance UX
eclair-performance-ux.goal: measure and reduce page weight and instability
eclair-performance-ux.model: LCP, CLS, INP, asset weight, CSS, JS, cache and fonts
eclair-performance-ux.procedure: Measure before/after via tools/measure.php --check, Chrome Lighthouse and a slow network, optimise images and scripts
eclair-performance-ux.invariant: Do not degrade the PHP cache path or disable CSP for the sake of convenience
eclair-performance-ux.pos: Test the public site without an extension, with an extension and on mobile
eclair-performance-ux.neg: A claimed improvement is accompanied by reproducible before/after measurements

eclair-multilingual-content.title: Multilingual content
eclair-multilingual-content.goal: publish a site in several languages with linked versions
eclair-multilingual-content.model: Content, language, linked version, address per language
eclair-multilingual-content.procedure: Check the languages supported by the site in the capabilities, organise a tree structure per language, link the versions and check hreflang
eclair-multilingual-content.invariant: No machine translation published without human review
eclair-multilingual-content.pos: Create a page in two languages and check cross-links and hreflang
eclair-multilingual-content.neg: A language without a translation does not lead to an empty page

eclair-language-switcher.title: Language switcher
eclair-language-switcher.goal: add a clear and accessible language switcher
eclair-language-switcher.procedure: List the languages by their name in their own language, point to the equivalent version, with no forced automatic redirect
eclair-language-switcher.invariant: No redirect by IP address; the visitor's choice is respected
eclair-language-switcher.pos: Switch language from a deep page and land on its equivalent
eclair-language-switcher.neg: With no equivalent, the link leads to the language's home page, not to an error

eclair-rtl-support.title: Right-to-left languages
eclair-rtl-support.goal: adapt the theme to Arabic or Hebrew
eclair-rtl-support.model: Text direction, CSS logical properties, directional icons
eclair-rtl-support.procedure: Use CSS logical properties in the site theme, test each template in dir=rtl
eclair-rtl-support.invariant: No user text is injected without escaping, including direction characters
eclair-rtl-support.pos: Display the typical pages right to left with no overflow
eclair-rtl-support.neg: A mix of languages does not break the reading order

eclair-locale-formats.title: Regional formats
eclair-locale-formats.goal: display dates, numbers, prices and addresses in each country's format
eclair-locale-formats.procedure: Centralise formatting on the server side, never hard-code a format in the templates
eclair-locale-formats.invariant: A displayed price always corresponds to the currency actually charged
eclair-locale-formats.pos: Compare a date and a price in French, English and German
eclair-locale-formats.neg: An unknown currency is not displayed with a misleading default symbol

eclair-translated-urls.title: Translated addresses
eclair-translated-urls.goal: translate addresses without losing search rankings
eclair-translated-urls.model: Address per language, redirects, canonical, hreflang
eclair-translated-urls.procedure: Set an address convention per language, translate the slugs before publication, check the canonical and hreflang produced by the core
eclair-translated-urls.invariant: No published address is changed without a redirect
eclair-translated-urls.pos: Check the canonical and hreflang of each version
eclair-translated-urls.neg: Two languages never share the same address

eclair-translation-workflow.title: Translation workflow
eclair-translation-workflow.goal: organise translation, review and updating of versions
eclair-translation-workflow.model: Source content, target version, translator, state, update date
eclair-translation-workflow.procedure: Keep a table of the content to translate, produce the translations as drafts, have them reviewed by a speaker of the language, flag outdated versions
eclair-translation-workflow.invariant: No legal or medical translation published without qualified validation
eclair-translation-workflow.pos: Translate a page, have it reviewed, publish, then modify the source and check the flag
eclair-translation-workflow.neg: An unreviewed translation remains a draft

eclair-contact-forms.title: Contact form
eclair-contact-forms.goal: set up the native contact form and its inbox
eclair-contact-forms.model: Message, name, e-mail, subject, date, read status
eclair-contact-forms.procedure: Place the native contact block, set the recipient, test sending and receipt, display the information notice
eclair-contact-forms.invariant: Messages are visible only to accounts with the Messages permission
eclair-contact-forms.pos: Send a real message and find it in the admin and by e-mail
eclair-contact-forms.neg: Repeated submissions in bursts are rate-limited by the core

eclair-form-inbox.title: Received messages
eclair-form-inbox.goal: handle received messages without losing any
eclair-form-inbox.procedure: Define who reads and replies, within what time, how long the messages are kept, how they are deleted
eclair-form-inbox.invariant: Limited retention period and restricted access permission
eclair-form-inbox.pos: Handle a message from receipt to archiving
eclair-form-inbox.neg: An account without the Messages permission has access to no message

eclair-multi-step-forms.title: Multi-step forms
eclair-multi-step-forms.goal: design a long form split into steps
eclair-multi-step-forms.procedure: Split by theme, validate on the server side at each step, plan for resuming and a summary before submission
eclair-multi-step-forms.invariant: No partial data is kept without informing the person
eclair-multi-step-forms.pos: Fill in, go back, correct and submit
eclair-multi-step-forms.neg: An invalid step blocks what follows and no incomplete data is transmitted

eclair-file-upload-forms.title: Forms with attachments
eclair-file-upload-forms.goal: design file uploads by visitors in complete security
eclair-file-upload-forms.model: Uploaded file, type, size, owner, retention period
eclair-file-upload-forms.procedure: Define accepted types and sizes, storage outside the public root, scanning and automatic deletion
eclair-file-upload-forms.invariant: No uploaded file is executable or served directly to the public
eclair-file-upload-forms.pos: Upload a valid file and find it on the admin side
eclair-file-upload-forms.neg: A file that is too heavy, disguised or executable is rejected

eclair-payment-forms.title: Payment forms
eclair-payment-forms.goal: collect a deposit, a donation or a simple service payment through a payment link
eclair-payment-forms.model: Service, amount, the provider's payment link
eclair-payment-forms.procedure: Create the link with the payment provider, display it on a clear page with terms, store nothing on the site
eclair-payment-forms.invariant: No banking data passes through or is stored on the site
eclair-payment-forms.pos: Pay in test mode and check the receipt and return page
eclair-payment-forms.neg: An amount modified on the browser side has no effect on the amount collected

eclair-surveys-polls.title: Polls and surveys
eclair-surveys-polls.wp: WP Polls, Quiz and Survey Master
eclair-surveys-polls.model: Question, choices, response, anonymous participant, aggregated results
eclair-surveys-polls.procedure: Define anonymity, limitation of multiple votes, display of aggregated results and duration of the poll
eclair-surveys-polls.invariant: No individual response is published; aggregated results only
eclair-surveys-polls.pos: Vote, view the results and close the poll
eclair-surveys-polls.neg: A second vote from the same participant is ignored

eclair-quote-requests.title: Quote requests
eclair-quote-requests.model: Request, service, budget, timeframe, contact details
eclair-quote-requests.procedure: Start with the native contact form and guided questions in the page; design the structured form for later
eclair-quote-requests.invariant: Only the data needed for the quote is requested
eclair-quote-requests.pos: Send a typical request and check that it is received in full
eclair-quote-requests.neg: A request without valid contact details is rejected with a clear message

eclair-conditional-forms.title: Conditional forms
eclair-conditional-forms.goal: design forms whose fields depend on the answers
eclair-conditional-forms.wp: Conditional logic of Gravity Forms or WPForms
eclair-conditional-forms.procedure: Describe the rules as data, apply them on the server side and on the browser side, test each branch
eclair-conditional-forms.invariant: Server validation never trusts fields hidden on the browser side
eclair-conditional-forms.pos: Go through each branch up to submission
eclair-conditional-forms.neg: A required field of an active branch cannot be bypassed

eclair-calculators.title: Simulators and calculators
eclair-calculators.goal: offer a price or measurement simulator with no data collection
eclair-calculators.procedure: Calculate in the browser with a formula validated by the client, display assumptions and limits, then offer a contact option
eclair-calculators.invariant: The result is indicative and stated as such; no input is sent to the server
eclair-calculators.pos: Compare the results with a set of cases calculated by hand
eclair-calculators.neg: An absurd or negative value displays a message, not a wrong result

eclair-seo-audit.title: Technical SEO audit
eclair-seo-audit.goal: check indexability, canonical, robots, links and performance
eclair-seo-audit.wp: Yoast SEO, Rank Math, audit tools
eclair-seo-audit.model: URLs, canonicals, sitemap, redirects, titles, HTTP statuses, structured data
eclair-seo-audit.procedure: Crawl the authorised pages, record discrepancies, prioritise structural causes, check coverage and the correction plan
eclair-seo-audit.invariant: Do not promise rankings; do not modify existing URLs without a redirect plan
eclair-seo-audit.pos: Test trailing slash, accents, paginations, 404, sitemap and robots
eclair-seo-audit.neg: No critical URL is orphaned or redirected in a chain after an update

eclair-geo-optimization.title: GEO and AI agents
eclair-geo-optimization.goal: make pages easier to read for search engines and AI assistants
eclair-geo-optimization.model: Verifiable content, provenance, semantics, llms.txt, Markdown, Schema.org
eclair-geo-optimization.procedure: Audit structure, factual answers, sources and consistency of the Markdown; check AI robots without over-promising
eclair-geo-optimization.invariant: Do not confuse internal GEO score, citability and guaranteed ranking
eclair-geo-optimization.pos: Test the Markdown version, structured citations and robots.txt
eclair-geo-optimization.neg: The facts displayed for robots and humans remain consistent and up to date

eclair-wordpress-migration.title: WordPress migration
eclair-wordpress-migration.goal: preserve URLs, content and traffic when migrating to éclair 2
eclair-wordpress-migration.model: WordPress export, old IDs, slugs, media, categories, authors, redirects and ?p= queries
eclair-wordpress-migration.procedure: Use the native WordPress feature; inventory historical URLs, simulate the import, compare slug/canonical, keep exact links and media, provide a rollback plan
eclair-wordpress-migration.invariant: Avoid 404s and URL deletions; never a DNS switchover without tests and backups
eclair-wordpress-migration.pos: Test URLs with trailing slash, query alias, accents, images and deleted pages
eclair-wordpress-migration.neg: For each old indexed URL, obtain an exact 200 or a targeted 301 redirect

eclair-structured-data.title: Structured data
eclair-structured-data.goal: add or check schema.org that is consistent with the content
eclair-structured-data.model: WebPage, Article, Product, relevant FAQ, Organization, BreadcrumbList
eclair-structured-data.procedure: Inspect the native JSON-LD before adding a type; avoid duplication; align each field with the visible data and the search engines' guidelines
eclair-structured-data.invariant: Éclair v2 does not yet expose all JSON-LD contributions to extensions; propose an RFC rather than opaque injection
eclair-structured-data.pos: Test valid JSON, canonical, identifiers and displayed content
eclair-structured-data.neg: No price/review/product that is invented or absent from the page appears in JSON-LD

eclair-multilingual-seo.title: Multilingual SEO
eclair-multilingual-seo.goal: manage several languages without duplication or wrong canonicals
eclair-multilingual-seo.model: Language, translation URL, reciprocal hreflang, title and sitemap
eclair-multilingual-seo.procedure: Inventory published languages, define the translation mapping, test canonical per language, hreflang/x-default and the absence of intrusive redirects
eclair-multilingual-seo.invariant: Do not use an unverified machine translation as a final page
eclair-multilingual-seo.pos: Test FR/ES/EN pairs, missing pages and language switching
eclair-multilingual-seo.neg: Each hreflang link points to an indexable, reciprocal 200 URL

eclair-meta-tags.title: Titles and meta descriptions
eclair-meta-tags.goal: write titles and descriptions with the native SEO analysis
eclair-meta-tags.wp: Yoast SEO, Rank Math, All in One SEO
eclair-meta-tags.model: Title, meta description, target phrase, result preview
eclair-meta-tags.procedure: Write a unique title and description for each page, use the editor's live score as an aid without treating it as a goal
eclair-meta-tags.invariant: No promise of position; no keyword stuffing
eclair-meta-tags.pos: Check uniqueness and length on all pages
eclair-meta-tags.neg: Two published pages do not have the same title

eclair-xml-sitemaps.title: XML sitemap
eclair-xml-sitemaps.goal: check the native sitemap and declare it to search engines
eclair-xml-sitemaps.procedure: Check the sitemap produced by the core, declare it in the search engines' tools, monitor coverage errors
eclair-xml-sitemaps.invariant: The sitemap lists only published and indexable pages
eclair-xml-sitemaps.pos: Validate the sitemap and compare it with the number of published pages
eclair-xml-sitemaps.neg: A draft or redirected page does not appear in it

eclair-redirects-manager.title: Redirects
eclair-redirects-manager.goal: manage 301 redirects with the native manager
eclair-redirects-manager.model: Old address, new address, type, date
eclair-redirects-manager.procedure: Import the old addresses, create one direct redirect per address, remove chains and loops
eclair-redirects-manager.invariant: No open redirect to an unintended domain
eclair-redirects-manager.pos: Test a batch of old addresses and record status and destination
eclair-redirects-manager.neg: No chain of more than one hop and no loop

eclair-local-seo.title: Local SEO
eclair-local-seo.goal: make a local business visible with the native data
eclair-local-seo.wp: Yoast Local SEO, Rank Math Local
eclair-local-seo.model: Name, address, telephone, opening hours, service area
eclair-local-seo.procedure: Enter the exact contact details in the settings, check the local business markup produced by the core, align the business listing and the site
eclair-local-seo.invariant: No invented address, review or service area
eclair-local-seo.pos: Compare the contact details of the site, the markup and the business listing
eclair-local-seo.neg: Unconfirmed opening hours are not published

eclair-social-previews.title: Sharing previews
eclair-social-previews.goal: polish the preview of pages shared on social networks and messaging apps
eclair-social-previews.procedure: Check the sharing tags and the image generated by the core, test the preview on the main platforms
eclair-social-previews.invariant: The sharing image contains no personal data and no misleading text
eclair-social-previews.pos: Test the preview of a post and of a page
eclair-social-previews.neg: A page without a dedicated image keeps a correct default preview

eclair-internal-linking.title: Internal linking
eclair-internal-linking.goal: link pages to one another for visitors and search engines
eclair-internal-linking.model: Source page, target page, anchor, orphan pages
eclair-internal-linking.procedure: Map the links, identify orphan pages, add useful links with descriptive anchors
eclair-internal-linking.invariant: No link is added automatically without reviewing the context
eclair-internal-linking.pos: Check that every important page receives at least one internal link
eclair-internal-linking.neg: No internal link points to a redirect or an error

eclair-newsletter-signup.title: Newsletter sign-up
eclair-newsletter-signup.goal: collect newsletter sign-ups by the rules
eclair-newsletter-signup.procedure: Use a sign-up page hosted by the e-mailing service or a link, as long as the site cannot receive sign-ups itself; double opt-in
eclair-newsletter-signup.invariant: No address is added to a list without explicit consent and proof
eclair-newsletter-signup.neg: An unconfirmed sign-up receives no mailing

eclair-email-campaigns.title: E-mail campaigns
eclair-email-campaigns.goal: design the sending of e-mail campaigns from the site's content
eclair-email-campaigns.procedure: Entrust sending to a specialised service, prepare the content from the site, define segments, frequency and unsubscription
eclair-email-campaigns.invariant: Every e-mail contains a working unsubscribe link; no purchased list
eclair-email-campaigns.pos: Send a test campaign to an internal list
eclair-email-campaigns.neg: An unsubscribed address no longer receives anything

eclair-popups-optins.title: Pop-ups and opt-in boxes
eclair-popups-optins.goal: display a discreet and respectful opt-in box
eclair-popups-optins.procedure: Prefer a box within the page; otherwise a native dialog triggered by a visitor action, closable with the keyboard, never on arrival
eclair-popups-optins.invariant: No window blocks the content or traps focus
eclair-popups-optins.pos: Open and close with the keyboard and on mobile
eclair-popups-optins.neg: A dismissed box does not reappear during the visit

eclair-landing-pages.title: Landing pages
eclair-landing-pages.goal: compose a targeted landing page with the native blocks
eclair-landing-pages.model: Promise, proof, offer, call to action
eclair-landing-pages.procedure: Write a page for a single intent, compose it in native blocks, link the action to a form or a payment link
eclair-landing-pages.invariant: No invented testimonial, figure or guarantee
eclair-landing-pages.pos: Go through the page on mobile up to the action
eclair-landing-pages.neg: Proof not provided by the client does not appear

eclair-ab-testing.title: A/B tests
eclair-ab-testing.goal: design A/B tests compatible with a site served from cache
eclair-ab-testing.procedure: Test over successive periods or with separate addresses rather than with variants in the cache; set hypothesis, duration and measurement in advance
eclair-ab-testing.invariant: No variant is stored in the shared cache per visitor
eclair-ab-testing.pos: Run a test on two separate landing pages
eclair-ab-testing.neg: A result without sufficient volume is not presented as conclusive

eclair-privacy-analytics.title: Privacy-friendly audience measurement
eclair-privacy-analytics.goal: measure the audience without cookies or profiling
eclair-privacy-analytics.procedure: Prefer the server logs or a self-hosted cookieless tool; a third-party script depends on the native content policy
eclair-privacy-analytics.invariant: No full IP address or visitor identifier is kept
eclair-privacy-analytics.pos: Compare the measured page views with a test journey
eclair-privacy-analytics.neg: No cookie is set by the measurement

eclair-social-sharing.title: Share buttons
eclair-social-sharing.goal: add sharing links without a third-party script
eclair-social-sharing.procedure: Use simple sharing links and the browser's share API as a progressive enhancement
eclair-social-sharing.invariant: No button loads a third-party script or tracker
eclair-social-sharing.pos: Share a page from mobile and desktop
eclair-social-sharing.neg: No third-party request before the click

eclair-social-feeds.title: Social media feeds
eclair-social-feeds.goal: display your latest social posts without weighing down the site
eclair-social-feeds.procedure: Retrieve the posts with a server-side scheduled task when the network allows it, render them as static HTML; otherwise simple links to the profiles
eclair-social-feeds.invariant: No third-party widget is loaded in visitors' browsers
eclair-social-feeds.pos: Check the static rendering and the update by task
eclair-social-feeds.neg: If the network is unavailable, the last valid version remains displayed

eclair-testimonials.title: Testimonials and reviews
eclair-testimonials.procedure: Collect real testimonials with written authorisation, present them as quotations, state the source
eclair-testimonials.invariant: No review that is invented, modified or selected in a misleading way
eclair-testimonials.pos: Check that every published testimonial has a recorded authorisation
eclair-testimonials.neg: A review without a verifiable source is not published

eclair-affiliate-links.title: Affiliate links
eclair-affiliate-links.goal: manage affiliate links with the native legal notices
eclair-affiliate-links.procedure: Enable the bundled affiliate feature, declare the programmes, let the core add the notice and the sponsored attribute
eclair-affiliate-links.invariant: No affiliate link without a visible advertising notice
eclair-affiliate-links.pos: Publish a comparison and check the notice and the link attributes
eclair-affiliate-links.neg: An affiliate link is never presented as an independent review

eclair-ads-adsense.title: Advertising
eclair-ads-adsense.wp: Ad Inserter, Site Kit, Advanced Ads
eclair-ads-adsense.procedure: Use the native Advertising page, limit the placements, check consent, label and impact on speed
eclair-ads-adsense.invariant: No advertising loaded before the required consent
eclair-ads-adsense.pos: Measure the page with and without advertising and check consent
eclair-ads-adsense.neg: Pages other than posts display no advertising

eclair-announcement-bars.title: Announcement bars
eclair-announcement-bars.model: Message, link, start and end dates
eclair-announcement-bars.procedure: Render the bar on the server side with validity dates, with no layout shift, removed automatically at expiry
eclair-announcement-bars.invariant: No expired announcement remains served by the cache
eclair-announcement-bars.pos: Display, close and let a bar expire
eclair-announcement-bars.neg: After the end date, the bar no longer appears on any page

eclair-commerce-pro.title: Commerce Pro architecture
eclair-commerce-pro.goal: design a complete shop, from the catalogue to the delivered order
eclair-commerce-pro.model: Catalogue, cart, prices frozen per line, order, payment, refund, stock, invoice and status log
eclair-commerce-pro.procedure: Design an order/payment state machine, separate public reads from private writes, choose transactional storage, formalise the PSP connector; identify the points not provided by Éclair v2
eclair-commerce-pro.invariant: No payment is declared successful from the browser redirect alone; the server validates an authenticated PSP event
eclair-commerce-pro.pos: Simulate purchase, webhook confirmation, retry, refund, stock and cancellation
eclair-commerce-pro.neg: Same payment notification delivered twice => a single order transition

eclair-product-catalog.title: Product catalogue
eclair-product-catalog.goal: build a fast, indexable public catalogue
eclair-product-catalog.model: Product, SKU, slug, title, description, display price, media, availability and category
eclair-product-catalog.procedure: First prototype a cacheable public GET page; produce a product schema and its index; keep source titles and descriptions; define pagination and canonical; preserve slugs across edits
eclair-product-catalog.invariant: The displayed price is never taken as the authoritative source for a future order
eclair-product-catalog.pos: Test categories, empty lists, canonical URL, search and soft deletion
eclair-product-catalog.neg: A deleted or private product must not remain in the catalogue or in an old cache

eclair-product-variants.title: Variants and attributes
eclair-product-variants.goal: model sizes, colours and configurations without pricing errors
eclair-product-variants.model: Parent product, variants with a unique SKU, attribute combinations, own prices/stock, media and status
eclair-product-variants.procedure: Define the maximum number of combinations; ensure SKU uniqueness; project variants into the GET rendering; prepare server-validated selection at checkout
eclair-product-variants.invariant: Never accept prices, weights or stock sent by the browser as reliable data
eclair-product-variants.pos: Test missing, out-of-stock and deactivated variants
eclair-product-variants.neg: Two combinations create the same SKU => explicit rejection before publication

eclair-cart-checkout.title: Cart and checkout flow
eclair-cart-checkout.goal: design a multi-line order with consistent prices and stock
eclair-cart-checkout.model: Temporary cart, member or guest session, lines, promotions, fees, taxes, order state
eclair-cart-checkout.procedure: Separate display from state change; revalidate each line on the server; calculate amounts in whole monetary units; reserve stock transactionally at the right moment
eclair-cart-checkout.invariant: No public write operation before a qualified POST route, CSRF, quotas and verified permissions
eclair-cart-checkout.pos: Test simultaneous cart modification, expiry and price change
eclair-cart-checkout.neg: Double or concurrent submission does not create two payable orders for the same key

eclair-orders-payments.title: Orders and payments
eclair-orders-payments.goal: implement order states and PSP providers
eclair-orders-payments.model: Order, payment attempt, provider identifier, webhook proof, idempotency key, refund
eclair-orders-payments.procedure: Detail the allowed transitions; store the proof of the notification and its timestamp; process webhooks durably; plan for reconciliation and partial refund
eclair-orders-payments.invariant: Never store raw bank card data; checkout hosted by the provider and webhook signatures verified
eclair-orders-payments.pos: Test reversed, out-of-order and re-sent webhooks and declined payment
eclair-orders-payments.neg: A webhook without a valid signature modifies neither the order nor LMS access

eclair-tax-invoicing.title: VAT and invoicing
eclair-tax-invoicing.goal: build the tax connection points suited to the jurisdiction
eclair-tax-invoicing.model: Country of sale and delivery, tax location, rate in force, invoice, credit note, sequence
eclair-tax-invoicing.procedure: List jurisdictions and customer types; consult up-to-date rules and accounting advice; freeze taxable base/rate at the time of the order; prepare exports of invoices and credit notes
eclair-tax-invoicing.invariant: Never apply a universal VAT rate or claim to ensure tax compliance without local validation
eclair-tax-invoicing.pos: Test domestic sale, cross-border sale, refund and rate change
eclair-tax-invoicing.neg: An invoice issued then cancelled must not be erased or silently renumbered

eclair-inventory.title: Stock and reservations
eclair-inventory.goal: synchronise actual stock between products, variants and orders
eclair-inventory.model: SKU, warehouse, physical stock, reserved, available, immutable movements
eclair-inventory.procedure: Design the inbound/outbound movements; lock the reservation; handle expiry and compensation; trace all manual corrections
eclair-inventory.invariant: The cacheable availability read is informational; every sale re-reads the stock within a transaction
eclair-inventory.pos: Test simultaneous purchases of the last item and release after expiry
eclair-inventory.neg: Two buyers cannot reserve the same last unit of stock

eclair-shipping.title: Delivery and shipping
eclair-shipping.goal: manage delivery zones, rates, tracking and statuses
eclair-shipping.model: Validated address, zone, carrier, parcel, weight, service, fees, tracking
eclair-shipping.procedure: Model zones and incompatibilities; calculate quotes on the server side; plan for split shipments and partial delivery; anonymise shipping data in logs
eclair-shipping.invariant: Address and tracking are private; no personal data in the public cache, detailed logs or URLs
eclair-shipping.pos: Test an unserved zone, weight limit, two parcels and lost status
eclair-shipping.neg: One customer's tracking number must not be visible from another account

eclair-discounts.title: Promotions and coupons
eclair-discounts.goal: create discounts and coupons that are consistent and not combined by mistake
eclair-discounts.model: Code, budget, dates, quota, cart conditions, usages and exclusions
eclair-discounts.procedure: Define calculation order and rounding; check the coupon before the order; count usages atomically; trace cancellation and return
eclair-discounts.invariant: The eligibility decision comes from server data and not from the discount entered in HTML
eclair-discounts.pos: Test expired and exhausted coupons, threshold and exclusions
eclair-discounts.neg: Two simultaneous orders cannot consume the last single coupon

eclair-commerce-analytics.title: Sales measurement
eclair-commerce-analytics.goal: track sales and conversions without exposing customer data
eclair-commerce-analytics.model: Funnel, confirmed orders, refunds, conversion rate, net revenue, consents
eclair-commerce-analytics.procedure: Define events and metrics without reusing sensitive data; reconcile order totals, credit notes and payments; plan for an aggregated summary
eclair-commerce-analytics.invariant: Personal analytics data requires a legal basis and must not leak through the cache
eclair-commerce-analytics.pos: Test revenue after refund and a break in counting
eclair-commerce-analytics.neg: The aggregation must neither count the same payment twice nor disclose an identifiable order

eclair-shop-setup.title: Opening the lightweight shop
eclair-shop-setup.goal: open the native lightweight shop with its legal pages
eclair-shop-setup.model: Product, price, category, legal notices, terms of sale
eclair-shop-setup.procedure: Publish the legal notices and terms of sale, open the shop, create the first product pages, check the catalogue and structured data
eclair-shop-setup.invariant: No price, lead time or term of sale invented by the agent
eclair-shop-setup.pos: Open the shop on a copy and go through the catalogue and a product page
eclair-shop-setup.neg: The shop does not open without published legal pages

eclair-payment-links.title: Payment links
eclair-payment-links.goal: link each product to a payment link from the provider
eclair-payment-links.wp: Stripe and PayPal gateways for WooCommerce
eclair-payment-links.model: Product or variant, payment link, provider
eclair-payment-links.procedure: Create the link with the provider, paste it into the product page or the variant, test in test mode, check receipt and refund on the provider side
eclair-payment-links.invariant: No banking data on the site; a link leads only to the provider's domain
eclair-payment-links.pos: Buy in test mode and check amount and receipt
eclair-payment-links.neg: A link to an unrecognised domain is rejected

eclair-merchant-feed.title: Product feed
eclair-merchant-feed.goal: distribute products to comparison sites through the native feed
eclair-merchant-feed.wp: Product Feed PRO, Google Listings and Ads
eclair-merchant-feed.procedure: Complete the product pages, check the feed produced by the core, declare it in the merchant tool, fix the rejections
eclair-merchant-feed.invariant: Price and availability in the feed are those of the public product page
eclair-merchant-feed.pos: Validate the feed and compare three products with their product pages
eclair-merchant-feed.neg: An unavailable product is not advertised as in stock

eclair-subscriptions-billing.title: Paid subscriptions
eclair-subscriptions-billing.goal: design recurring subscriptions managed by the payment provider
eclair-subscriptions-billing.model: Plan, period, subscriber, due date, status
eclair-subscriptions-billing.procedure: Let the provider manage direct debits and the customer area; design the synchronisation of permissions through signed events
eclair-subscriptions-billing.invariant: An access right is opened only on an authenticated payment event
eclair-subscriptions-billing.pos: Simulate subscription, renewal, failure and cancellation
eclair-subscriptions-billing.neg: A failed payment extends no access
